rows.label: Drone endurance hours
rows.envelope: 0.25 to 1.0 h is plausible for prosumer multirotor concepts before battery and payload proof.
rows.evidenceRequired: Confirm payload mass, hover power, battery usable energy, reserve margin, wind and take-off weight.

rows.label: Drone 20% reserve time
rows.envelope: Reserve planning marker only; flight controller failsafe needs detailed energy budget.
rows.interpretation: 8 minutes reserved at 20% of stated endurance.
rows.evidenceRequired: Confirm return-to-home reserve, hover reserve, battery ageing, wind case and payload power.
